company.description: A simple, intelligent, and intuitive financial empowerment app that offers users a unique understanding of personal finances and the ability to securely plan, keep track of their income and expenses in real-time, and reach goals faster. Mafhoom, using open banking technology, aggregates and centralizes all user’s accounts in one interface to keep clients on top of their accounts, bills, and subscriptions.
